unit_definition: A group of poultry establishments linked by common ownership, pooled across all included years and all fourteen drugs
cohort_selection_rule: All 19 calibration and 30 test groups of fsis_split.csv with all fourteen drug panels; four NARMS blocks provide training only
roster_provenance: FSIS groups assigned by the ascending SHA-256 of the group identifier (fsis_split.csv); NARMS training blocks KS, MN, CO and OR. Development data (evaluation/PROTOCOL.md, section 1).
counts_provenance: Complete original FSIS calibration histograms and NARMS training histograms, including zeros and censored categories. FSIS target histograms are excluded from these inputs.
